# Header-truth regression fixtures

Two captures of contradictions the Command Center header rendered on live release
`a7c550d1d201e6b44b6f849a6e1f9efe72ce4fe9` (2026-09-04). Both are verbatim from
production payloads, reduced to the fields that carry the contradiction. They are
inputs to the producer contracts, not expectations — the tests assert the
producers now describe them honestly.

| fixture | contradiction |
|---|---|
| `clock_contradiction_20260903_20260904.json` | header dated `2026-09-03` over a book valued `2026-09-04`, 99.6% of whose value was last observed in July |
| `count_contradiction_48_60_0.json` | `48 classified / 60 scanned / 0 excluded` — 12 rows unaccounted, and `scanned` itself disagreed 60 vs 49 |

Neither file is regenerated by tooling. If a producer change makes a test here
fail, the fixture is the evidence and the change is the suspect.
